application of positive isolation devices and personal locks

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: fire on P-4105 during a statutory inspection

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access on P-4105 and TT-4105 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in applying and verifying an isolation, specifically proving dead and testing for zero energy. P-4105 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was not in place. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 6 March 2015 an incident occurred on P-4105 and TT-4105 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a statutory inspection, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
